faqQ1: How do I activate my plan after payment?
faqA1: Log in with the email used at purchase. Your plan will be activated automatically within minutes of payment.
faqQ2: Can I cancel my monthly or annual subscription?
faqA2: Yes, you can cancel anytime from your Maketou dashboard. Your Premium access remains active until the end of the paid period.
faqQ3: Does the Lifetime plan include future updates?
faqA3: Yes, absolutely. All future updates to Blockweb Master are included forever, with no additional cost.
faqA4: We offer a full refund within 7 days if you're not satisfied. Contact support with your purchase email.
faqQ5: Is my plan tied to a single device?
faqA5: No, your license is linked to your email account. You can use it on all your devices by logging in with the same email.
faqQ6: What is the difference between the Annual and Lifetime plans?
faqA6: The Annual plan renews each year at $27. The Lifetime plan is a one-time payment of $45 that gives you access to Blockweb Master forever — paid off in less than 2 years.
